drafts.passage: Gimlet-L outperforms Ostler on both benchmarks, achieving a pass rate of 66.0% versus 61.2% on Kiln-Py and 31.1% versus 23.5% on Kiln-PyX. The improvement is larger on the repository-level Kiln-PyX (7.6 percentage points) than on the function-level Kiln-Py (4.8 percentage points). No statistical tests were reported, so the reliability of these differences is not established.
